content: Tris-Buffered Saline, commonly abbreviated as TBS, is a buffer solution utilized in various biochemical techniques to maintain a stable pH environment. The concentrations of Tris and sodium chloride (NaCl), as well as the pH of the solution, can vary depending on the specific application. Despite these variations, the solution is still referred to as TBS. The concentration of Tris, which provides the buffering capacity of the solution, typically ranges from 10 mM to 100 mM. The sodium chloride concentration can also differ, with isotonic conditions generally containing 0.9% NaCl, while hypertonic conditions may involve a higher concentration, such as 500 mM NaCl.
